login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to your Square Share creator dashboard.

linkErrors.invalidLink: That link is invalid or has expired. Try signing in again.
linkErrors.resetExpired: That password reset link has expired. Request a new one below.
linkErrors.oauth: Google sign-in could not be started. Please try again.

login.usernameHint: Letters, numbers and underscores. You can sign in with this instead of your email.
login.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, mixing cases, numbers or symbols (or a passphrase of 16+).
login.cta: {mode, select, signup {Create account} magic {Send magic link} other {Sign in}}
login.pendingCta: {mode, select, signup {Creating account…} magic {Sending link…} other {Signing in…}}
login.useMagicLink: Email me a magic link instead

passwordReset.title: Reset your password
passwordReset.description: Enter your email and we'll send a link to set a new one.

resetPassword.heading: Set a new password
resetPassword.intro: Pick something you’ll remember. You’re signed in on this device once it’s set.

twoFactor.heading: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.introNamed: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app ({name}).
twoFactor.introAs: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in as {email}.
twoFactor.introNamedAs: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app ({name}) to finish signing in as {email}.

recovery.heading: Use a recovery code
recovery.intro: Enter one of the codes you saved when you turned on two-factor authentication.
recovery.label: Recovery code
recovery.warning: Each code works once. Using one turns two-factor authentication off and signs out your other devices, so you can set it up again on your new phone.

passkey.intro: Use your passkey to finish signing in.
passkey.introAs: Use your passkey to finish signing in as {email}.
passkey.hint: Face ID, your fingerprint or your screen lock. If your passkey is on your phone, your computer shows a QR code to scan with it.
passkey.cancelled: The passkey prompt was closed. Try again when you're ready.
passkey.unsupported: This browser can't use passkeys. Try another browser, or use a recovery code.
passkey.failed: Your device couldn't use the passkey. Try again.
passkey.elsewhere: Did your phone say it has no passkey for Square Share? Then your passkey is saved on another device. You can approve this sign-in from any phone where you're signed in instead.

approval.intro: Scan this code with your phone's camera, then approve the sign-in on your phone.
approval.introAs: Scan this code with your phone's camera, then approve the sign-in on your phone to finish signing in as {email}.

steps.camera: Open your phone's camera and point it at the code.
steps.open: Tap the link that appears. Square Share opens on your phone.
steps.approve: Check it's this device, then tap Approve.

approval.qrAlt: QR code that opens the approval page on your phone
approval.signedInThere: Your phone needs to be signed in to Square Share, in the app or the browser. If it isn't, you can sign in on it first.
approval.cantScan: Can't scan it? Copy the link and open it on your phone:
approval.denied: The sign-in was denied on your other device.
approval.failed: We couldn't make a code just now.

passkeyHere.title: Skip the phone next time
passkeyHere.body: Create a passkey on this device, and next time you'll sign in here with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
passkeyHere.added: Passkey added. Next time, sign in here with one tap.
passkeyHere.cancelled: The passkey prompt was closed. Try again, or skip it for now.
passkeyHere.exists: This device already has a passkey for your account.
passkeyHere.failed: This device couldn't create a passkey. You can add one later in Settings › Security.

stepUp.description: This is a sensitive change. Enter the current code from your authenticator app to confirm it's you.
stepUp.codeHint: The 6 digits in your app right now.
stepUp.passkeyDescription: This is a sensitive change. Confirm it's you with your passkey.
stepUp.passkeyCancelled: The passkey prompt was closed. Try again.
stepUp.passkeyUnsupported: This browser can't use passkeys. Use a code from your authenticator app, or another browser.
stepUp.passkeyFailed: Your device couldn't use the passkey. Try again.
stepUp.useCodeInstead: Use a code from your authenticator app instead

success.signUpCheckEmail: Check your email for a link to confirm your account. If you already have an account with that address, sign in instead — or reset your password if you've forgotten it.
success.magicLinkSent: Check your email for a link to sign in.
success.resetLinkOnItsWay: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.

approve.heading: Sign in on another device?
approve.intro: Someone is signing in to your account and asked this device to approve it.
approve.introAs: Someone is signing in to {email} and asked this device to approve it.
approve.warning: Only approve if you are signing in right now and can see that device. Square Share will never ask you to approve a sign-in for anyone else.

approved.heading: Sign-in approved
approved.body: Go back to your other device: it finishes signing in by itself.

denied.heading: Sign-in denied
denied.body: Nobody was signed in. If it wasn't you trying, someone knows your password: change it now.

expired.heading: This request has expired
expired.body: It was already answered, or the code timed out. To try again, show a new code on the device you're signing in on.

otherAccount.heading: This request is for another account
otherAccount.body: The signed-in account here isn't the one being signed in to. Sign in to that account on this device to approve it.

signIn.heading: Sign in to approve
signIn.body: To approve a sign-in from this device, sign in to Square Share here first. You'll come straight back to this page.
